cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Extend your umbrella and tap for it; I'll tell you where.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The stick won't reach. Don't choose equipment by whose it is. Keep your feet on this bank and extend the umbrella.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe, but finding a surface won't prove it can hold us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then slide your picnic basket onto it. Keep hold of the handle, please. We're testing a load, not donating lunch.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 equipment correction and A5 loading instruction combine expert supervision with getting B to test the impossible claim.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 says a walking stick cannot reach the surface, but A5 asks for a hand-held basket there without explaining access.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers A's tool and B4 sensibly questions what surface detection proves.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 load concern, but the test assumes reachable support before B has performed the probe.

specificity.evidence: A1 ditch and invisible bridge are explicit; A3 reach limit makes A5 physical setup unclear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 lunch line serves retaining the basket but does not cure the spatial contradiction.
